claims.conclusion: Error identified and characterized under ASC 250-10-20.
claims.statement: December hosting fees of 15,000.00 USD (FY2024) and 10,000.00 USD (FY2025) were not accrued at either year end: an error in previously issued financial statements, not a change in estimate.

claims.conclusion: Quantified by period; cumulative correction recomputes.
claims.statement: Accrued liabilities are restated from 120,000.00 to 135,000.00 USD at 2024-12-31 and from 135,000.00 to 160,000.00 USD at 2025-12-31; the cumulative correction at 2026-01-01 is 25,000.00 USD.
Under SAB 108 the misstatement is 3.75% of FY2025 pretax income by rollover and 6.25% by iron curtain; with the SAB 99 qualitative factors considered it is material.

The error is corrected by restatement: a 25,000.00 USD prior-period adjustment to opening retained earnings against accrued liabilities as of 2026-01-01, with the FY2024 and FY2025 statements restated.
The restatement discloses that previously issued statements were restated, the nature of the error, and the effect on each line item, income and retained earnings for each period presented.
